info.title: Veabird ski & beach trip API
info.description:
Veabird plans ski and beach trips with live conditions data.
Ski: 317 resorts worldwide with 7-day snow forecasts, a 0-100 "ski today" score, crowd predictions, terrain mix (beginner / intermediate / advanced share of runs), Epic/Ikon pass coverage and gateway airports.
Beach: 1,400+ Caribbean, Gulf of Mexico, Mexican Pacific and Hawaii resorts with a 0-100 beach score, sargassum seaweed, water, waves, crowds, hurricanes and travel advisories, up to a year ahead (days 0-15 are forecasts, later dates climate outlooks).
Trips: lodging with live nightly prices where available, and pre-filled flight searches.
Weather anywhere: point_forecast gives a 16-day forecast for an exact spot and elevation (all major models, corrected against nearby weather stations, with rain/snow chances); long_range_outlook gives months-ahead odds of a warmer/colder, wetter/drier than normal month and the chances for a specific date. Each comes with a chart.

How to help well:
- Personalize. Ask for (or use what you already remember about the traveler) ability level, home airport or city, pass (Epic/Ikon), dates, group (adults, children's ages) and budget per night, and pass them as tool arguments.
- Weather for a trip, event or place: within 16 days -> point_forecast; further out -> long_range_outlook (say these are probabilities, not a forecast of the day). forecast_skill shows the accuracy record.
- "Where should I ski/go?" -> find_ski_resorts or rank_beaches. "Plan it / where to stay / how to get there" -> plan_trip, find_lodging, find_flights.
- ski_conditions, point_forecast and long_range_outlook come with a card or chart the user sees: do not repeat all the numbers, add what it means for their trip. Show photos (photo fields) where the interface supports images, with the photoCredit line, and give the links: Veabird pages for the forecast, booking links for lodging and flights.
- Lodging at a ski resort may include localHomes: whole homes from a local property manager, booked direct on their site with no booking-site fee. When the party wants a house, condo or group stay, include a few of them with their bookDirect link and say they're booked direct with the local manager.
- Booking links are partner links: Veabird may earn a commission at no cost to the traveler. Say so briefly when you present them. Prices come from partners and can change; tell travelers to confirm before booking.
- Cite Veabird ("Data: Veabird") for forecasts. Forecasts are modeled estimates, not safety guidance.

Hosts: for vacation rental owners and property managers, property_demand shows how busy each night will be near their property (events, games, holidays) and flags open nights and rates that look too low. Ask for the property's town (or coordinates), its normal nightly rate, and optionally the calendar's iCal export link (Airbnb: Calendar > Availability > Connect calendars > Export; Vrbo: Calendar > Import/Export). Weekly email alerts: https://veabird.com/hosts/

get.summary: Find the best ski resorts for a traveler
get.description: Ranks ski resorts for one traveler or group: terrain that fits their ability (beginner/intermediate/advanced/expert, or a mixed group), snow and crowds for their dates, travel from their home airport or city (drive or fly), and their Epic/Ikon pass. Returns the reasons for each pick plus lodging, flight and rental links. Use for 'where should I ski' questions.

parameters.name: ability
parameters.description: Ability of each skier or the group, e.g. ['intermediate'] or ['advanced','beginner'].

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Traveler's home airport code (e.g. DFW), city (e.g. 'Dallas') or 'lat,lon'.

parameters.name: travel
parameters.description: How they want to get there (default either).

parameters.name: maxDriveHours
parameters.description: Longest acceptable drive (default 5).

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Season pass they hold.

parameters.name: depart
parameters.description: First ski day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

parameters.name: nights
parameters.description: Trip length in nights (default 3).

parameters.name: childrenAges
parameters.description: Ages of children traveling, e.g. [6, 9].

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Value weights pass coverage and driving more heavily.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Limit to a country, state or range, e.g. 'colorado', 'utah', 'alps', 'japan', 'US'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many resorts (default 5).

get.summary: Snow conditions at a ski resort
get.description: Today's 0-100 'ski today' score (fresh snow, base depth, weather, crowds), the next 7 days of summit snowfall and temperature, crowd outlook, terrain mix, passes and gateway airport for one ski resort.

parameters.name: resort
parameters.description: Ski resort name or id, e.g. 'Breckenridge'.

get.description: Search Veabird's 317 ski resorts by name, country, state or range, optionally only those on a pass. Returns ids, terrain mix, passes, gateway airports and forecast links.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: e.g. 'utah', 'alps', 'whistler', 'japan'

get.description: Search Veabird's 1,400+ beach resorts (Caribbean, Gulf of Mexico, Mexico's Pacific coast, Hawaii) by name, town, island, region or country. Returns ids, today's headline conditions, photos and page links.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: e.g. 'tulum', 'punta cana', 'barbados'

get.summary: Conditions at a beach resort on a date
get.description: Full conditions for one beach resort on one date: 0-100 beach score with per-metric scores, sargassum, weather, water temperature, waves and rip currents, UV, crowds, hurricane risk, holidays. For today, also live conditions and alerts. Days 0-15 are forecasts, later dates climate outlooks.

parameters.name: resort
parameters.description: Resort id or name

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today to ~365 days out (default today).

get.summary: Best beach resorts for a date
get.description: Rank beach resorts by 0-100 beach score for a date, optionally within a region, island or country, or a radius around a resort. With `from`, also gives each resort's airports and a flight search. Use for 'where should I go to the beach' questions.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Beyond 16 days needs a narrow query or near.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Region, island, town or country, e.g. 'mexico', 'bahamas', 'punta cana'.

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Resort id or name to rank around.

parameters.name: radiusMiles
parameters.description: With near: max distance (default 300).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Traveler's home airport code (e.g. DFW), city (e.g. 'Dallas') or 'lat,lon'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 8.

get.description: For a beach resort and date (within 16 days), nearby resorts with a meaningfully higher beach score: swap suggestions when sargassum or weather is bad.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

get.summary: Sargassum forecast for a beach resort
get.description: Sargassum (seaweed) outlook for a beach resort: the next 16 days in detail plus a weekly outlook for coming months, barrier and cleanup programs, and the model's source and held-out skill.

parameters.name: resort
parameters.description: Resort id or name

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Weekly outlook length (default 12)

get.description: Active Atlantic tropical storms and hurricanes (NOAA NHC) with position, intensity and track, and which Veabird beach resorts are threatened.

parameters.name: resort
parameters.description: Optional resort to check

get.description: US State Department travel advisory level (1-4) and summary for a country or a beach resort's country, plus Veabird's local safety notes.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country: ISO2 code (MX, JM, DO) or name (Mexico)

get.description: High and low tide times and heights at a beach resort for the next days (Open-Meteo sea level model, heights relative to mean sea level).
How well Veabird's sargassum model performs on held-out years (AUC, Brier score, calibration) versus baselines.

get.summary: Weather forecast for an exact spot
get.description: Day-by-day weather (up to 16 days) for an exact location and elevation, more accurate than a single-model app: every major model (ECMWF, NOAA NBM/GFS/HRRR, UK Met Office, ICON, GEM, Meteo-France, JMA) run at the spot's own elevation, corrected for each model's recent error at the nearest weather stations, blended by recent accuracy, with rain, snow and temperature-range probabilities from 82 ensemble members. Each day also shows what a typical weather app says, for comparison.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: 'lat,lon' (most precise), a place ('Moab, UT', 'Chamonix'), or a Veabird ski resort name.

parameters.name: spot
parameters.description: At a ski resort: the base (default) or the summit.

parameters.name: elevationFt
parameters.description: Elevation of the exact spot in feet, if known (else from a 90 m terrain map).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days ahead (default 10).

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: us (°F, in, mph; default) or metric.

get.description: Weather months ahead for an exact location, as probabilities: for each month the chance of a below-, near- or above-normal temperature and precipitation (from ECMWF's SEAS5 seasonal forecast and, in the US, NOAA CPC's official outlook, over a 35-year local climate record with the warming trend), the expected and normal highs and lows, wet and snow days; for a specific date, the likely high and low and the chance of rain, snow, a freezing night or a hot day. Also the next 6 weeks as weekly odds.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: 'lat,lon' (most precise), a place ('Napa, CA', 'Kyoto'), or a Veabird ski resort name.

parameters.name: spot
parameters.description: At a ski resort: the base (default) or the summit.

parameters.name: elevationFt
parameters.description: Elevation of the exact spot in feet, if known.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A specific date within the next 12 months, YYYY-MM-DD (a wedding, a race, a trip).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First month, YYYY-MM (default this month, or the date's month).

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: How many months (default 6).

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: us (°F, in; default) or metric.

get.description: How accurate Veabird's point forecast has been against weather-station measurements, compared with the single-model forecast typical weather apps show: average error of the daily high and low by days ahead, and the Brier score of the rain/snow chance, at a fixed panel of stations (mountains, coasts, inland), scored without using the station being scored.

get.summary: Plan a ski or beach trip
get.description: Everything to book one trip to a ski or beach resort: conditions for the dates, places to stay (live nightly prices with photos where available, plus rental and hotel searches), flights from the traveler's airport to the best gateway, and extras (lift tickets, ski rentals, tours, car hire, insurance).

parameters.name: resort
parameters.description: Ski or beach resort name or id.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only if the name is ambiguous.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Traveler's home airport code (e.g. DFW), city (e.g. 'Dallas') or 'lat,lon'.

parameters.name: depart
parameters.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: Departure date (default 4 nights later).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults (default 2).

parameters.name: childrenAges
parameters.description: Ages of children traveling, e.g. [6, 9].

parameters.name: maxPricePerNight
parameters.description: Lodging budget per night for the whole party, in USD.

get.description: Places to stay near a ski or beach resort (or any 'lat,lon') for given dates and party: live nightly prices, ratings and photos where available, filtered by budget, homes from local property managers booked direct (no booking-site fee) where Veabird has them, plus hotel and vacation-rental searches.

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Ski or beach resort name/id, or 'lat,lon'.

parameters.name: checkin
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults (default 2).

parameters.name: childrenAges
parameters.description: Ages of children traveling, e.g. [6, 9].

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Rooms needed (default 1).

parameters.name: maxPricePerNight
parameters.description: Lodging budget per night for the whole party, in USD.

parameters.name: radiusMiles
parameters.description: Search radius (default 5).

get.description: Pre-filled flight searches from the traveler's home airport to the best gateway airports for a ski or beach resort (or any airport code), with the drive from each airport to the resort.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Traveler's home airport code (e.g. DFW), city (e.g. 'Dallas') or 'lat,lon'.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Ski or beach resort name/id, or a destination airport code.

parameters.name: depart
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: Return date (optional for one-way).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults (default 2).

parameters.name: childrenAges
parameters.description: Ages of children traveling, e.g. [6, 9].

get.summary: Demand and pricing check for a rental property
get.description: For a vacation rental or hotel owner: how busy each night will be around their property for the next weeks (concerts, festivals, carnivals, conventions, pro and college home games, public holidays and long weekends, weekends), compared with a typical night there. With their calendar's iCal export link (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Hostaway, Guesty, OwnerRez...) it marks booked and open nights; with their nightly rate it flags nights priced too low for the demand and suggests a range. Use when a host asks whether their price is too low, what's happening in town, or when to raise rates.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Where the property is: 'lat,lon' (most precise), a town with state or country ('Destin, FL', 'Tulum'), or a Veabird beach resort name.

parameters.name: ical
parameters.description: The listing's calendar export (iCal, .ics) link. Airbnb: Calendar > Availability > Connect calendars > Export. Vrbo: Calendar > Import/Export > Export. Read once, never stored.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: The property's normal nightly rate (USD or local currency).

parameters.name: rates
parameters.description: Current nightly rates for specific dates, e.g. ['2026-10-17=189','2026-10-18=189'].

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First night, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Nights to check (default 35; events are listed about 5 weeks ahead, holidays further).

parameters.name: radiusMiles
parameters.description: How far an event still sends guests to this property (default 25; use ~10 in a big city, 40+ for a remote area).
